title: Teardown, Supplement and Short Pay Thresholds for Insurer Program Agreements
content:
How much disassembly a center may perform before insurer approval, the largest supplement it may self-approve and the short pay the network writes off without dispute are set by the tier of the insurer's agreement under the Insurer Program Agreements:

- **Pre-approved teardown** — disassembly hours the center may perform before insurer approval (hours, to one decimal).
- **Supplement self-approval limit** — the largest supplement the center may self-approve under the agreement (US dollars; 0.00 means none).
- **Short pay write-off** — the short pay per repair order the network writes off without dispute (US dollars; 0.00 means none).

| Agreement tier | Pre-approved teardown (hours) | Supplement self-approval limit (USD) | Short pay write-off per repair order (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 1.0 | 500.00 | 25.00 |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 2.0 | 1000.00 | 50.00 |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 3.0 | 1500.00 | 75.00 |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 4.0 | 2500.00 | 100.00 |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 4.0 | 2500.00 | 100.00 |

## Notes

- Under a Network Referral Agreement all three figures are zero: no teardown hours before insurer approval, no supplement the center self-approves (0.00 means none), and no short pay written off without dispute (0.00 means none).
- The supplement limit is the largest single supplement the center may self-approve; a supplement equal to the limit is within it.
- The short pay figure is per repair order.

## Questions on the thresholds

**How much disassembly may a center do on a Premier Direct Repair Agreement claim before the insurer approves?** Up to 3.0 hours.

**Is a supplement of 1000.00 within a Preferred Direct Repair Agreement center's own authority?** Yes; the limit is 1000.00 and the supplement equals it. A supplement of 1000.01 on the same tier is above it.

**On a repair order under a Select Direct Repair Agreement, is a short pay of 30.00 within the write-off figure?** No; the figure is 25.00 per repair order. A short pay of 25.00 is within it.
